info.name: Monodex
info.description:
Collection da API Monodex (gym-ctrl + notifly).

## Contrato (breaking)
`/admin/*` **foi removido**. Use:
- `/platform/*` — SUPER_ADMIN (`{{platformToken}}`)
- `/tenant/:tenantId/*` — ADMIN do tenant (`{{tenantToken}}`)
- `POST /auth/login` — inalterado

## Como usar
1. Importe este arquivo no Postman.
2. Ajuste `gymBaseUrl` (GYM_PORT, default 3001), `notiflyBaseUrl`, emails e senhas.
3. Rode **Auth → Login Super Admin** (grava `platformToken`) e **Login Tenant Admin** (grava `tenantToken` e `tenantId` do JWT).
4. Pastas `Platform — *` usam Bearer `{{platformToken}}`. Pastas `Tenant — *` usam `{{tenantToken}}`.

## Seeds locais
```bash
NODE_ENV=development npx ts-node prisma/seed-platform-admin.ts
npx ts-node prisma/seed-outreach.ts
```
Platform admin (dev): `platform-admin@local.dev` / `platform-admin-dev`.
`seed-outreach` upserta policy vazia + grants dos stubs `test_gladson` e notify no tenant operacional (id 8 / `TENANT_ID`).

item.description:
Ordem típica:
1. Auth → Login Super Admin
2. Platform — Tenants → Create Tenant
3. Platform — First User → Create First User
4. Platform — Coins → Credit
5. Platform — Template Grants → Grant stubs
6. Auth → Login Tenant Admin
7. Tenant — Outreach → PUT/PATCH knobs
8. Platform — Outreach → PATCH preço
9. Tenant — Lists → Create `{ name }` + Platform PATCH costPerSend
